title: CHUSPAN SCS BP Treatment of Churg-Strauss Syndrome Without Poor-Prognosis Factors
brief_summary: To assess the efficacy of systemic corticosteroids alone as first-line treatment of Churg-Strauss syndrome without poor-prognosis factors as defined by the five-factor score (FFS=0), and to compare the efficacy and safety of azathioprine vs pulse cyclophosphamide as adjunctive immunosuppressive therapy to treat failure or relapse
